item.title: Playrooms
item.description:
Title: Playrooms
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Two Pixels UG
Publisher: Two Pixels UG
Release Date: Nov 4, 2026




About This Game

Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.

You don't know how long you've been working here, but you know what needs doing: over 200,000 balls are scattered everywhere, and you bring them back to their ball pits. Nobody told you why.

Your Job

Collect the balls. Bring them back. Fill the ball pits. Full ball pits unlock new abilities, and collected balls are your currency. Eventually you'll have enough for the key to the next area. The work stays the same, only the room changes. Tiles, water, endless corridors, a hallway with more doors than it should have.

Tools

The more balls you collect, the more equipment you can afford. A scoop or a flashlight. Everything you need to keep working.

Observe Working Hours

When your shift is over, the lights start to go out one by one. Then there is only one thing that matters: stay in the light! Because you don't want to find out what is waiting for you in the darkness.

Flexible Working Arrangements

No fear at all, the way it’s meant to be, or no second chances? You decide how dangerous your job gets.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

A horror game set in liminal environments inspired by the Backrooms concept. Contains jumpscares with sudden loud sound effects and extended sequences in near-total darkness.

No blood or graphic violence, no sexual content, no nudity, no depiction of drug or alcohol use.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 580
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Standard
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 5700
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Standard

item.title: VOID/BREAKER
item.description:
Title: VOID/BREAKER
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Stubby Games
Publisher: Playstack
Release Date: Nov 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 19, 2025




About This Game

You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI.
You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat.

The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here.

B̷̫̬̗̈́Ȕ̸̲̾̕T̸̛̮͌̀ ̴̢͕̊͋̚ͅ ̵̠̪͙̥̄ ̸̡̼̦̬̎ ̸̣̟̺̘̀͛ ̶̛͚͔͍̍̀Ẽ̷̥͉͑̈S̷͓̑C̵̰͍̬̆̔͐A̷̡̓̀̌P̸̺͇̰͐̊͜E̷͕̼̘͇̾ ̴͚̻͎͙͋̿̂̾ ̷̡̲̗̅̋̇͘ ̸̝̖̗̀̀͒̈ ̸̛̲͌̋I̸̢̟̠̓̃ͅS̷͈͋̇̕ ̴̳̺͋̍̊̿ ̵̲̩̾ ̶̧̙̯̓͑̏ ̸̢̿̀̈́ ̵̗̦͎͂̍̓ ̸̼͎͋̕P̷͙̟̔̚Ő̵͓S̴͉̞̝̟͌S̷̜͔̤͗̿̽Ȋ̴̩̠͉̲̚Ḃ̶̙͉L̵̺̔́͝Ę̶͙̩͆̌

Lightning-Fast Gunplay & Flawless Movement

This isn’t just shooting - it’s pure velocity.

Run through relentless gunfights with fluid movement designed for high-paced action.
Outmaneuver your enemies and dominate every firefight with agility and speed.

Infinite Weapons. Infinite Possibilities

Discover limitless weapon combinations using the ultimate gun-modding system.
Strategically combine mods to create devastating loadouts.
Unlock wild synergies that turn you into an unstoppable force.

Destruction is your Advantage.

Why just shoot your enemies when you can tear down the world around them?
Environmental destruction isn't just for show - it's a core gameplay mechanic.
Blast through walls, collapse structures, and stagger enemies to survive.

New Run. New Choices. New Paths

Every run presents decisions. Which fights do you take?

Which paths push your limits?

Do you take the dangerous route for bigger rewards or play it safe?

The choice is yours

A Passion Project by a Solo Developer

VOID/BREAKER is a solo project from developer Daniel Stubbington, known as Stubby Games.

Following his acclaimed Portal-inspired puzzle game, The Entropy Centre (2022),

Daniel now pursues his passion for dynamic FPS gameplay and roguelites.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 14 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 14 GB available space

item.title: Sushiamo
item.description:
Title: Sushiamo
Genre: Casual , Indie , Strategy
Developer: Panello Games
Publisher: Panello Games
Franchise: One More Run
Release Date: Nov 4, 2026




About This Game

Sushiamo is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-builder where you combine unique ingredients, tools, and sauces to create crazy sushi and trigger game-breaking combos.

Find the synergy

Every ingredient has a distinct bonus and synergy with other ingredients. Experiment to find the best combo!
Build your perfect kitchen by collecting the right ingredients, tools and sauces to progress through increasingly higher scoring requirements and become a sushi master.

Choose Your Path

Navigate through a map that changes every run, where every choice matters, take the safer path or risk it all for greater rewards.
Encounter unexpected events along the way that can grant you game-changing bonuses or set you back.

So much content to unlock

  • 🌊 Over 300+ items to discover

  • 🎐 A market to discover your perfect setup

  • 🍥 Unlockable ingredients, tools, sauces and more

Credits: Trailer Music by " Won Jong Hwa "

item.title: Lightyear Frontier
item.description:
Title: Lightyear Frontier
Developer: FRAME BREAK
Publisher: FRAME BREAK , Coffee Stain Publishing
Release Date: Nov 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Mar 19, 2024




About This Game

Lightyear Frontier is an open-world mech farming game for 1-4 players. Settle your intergalactic homestead, build a farm, and craft a machine able to provide for the struggling frontier colonies.

Work at scale using your powerful mech. Plant vast fields using the rapid-firing Seed Shooter and haul dozens of logs on one shoulder. Crop rotation and fertilizer reward the farmers who plan ahead.

Build your ideal farm, whether that’s a cozy homestead or the ultimate resource generator. Decorate a home to call your own and unlock useful effects. Improve your quality of life by laying down roads and automating upkeep, like crafting and watering.

Up to three friends can join you on your farm. Pool your resources to create the perfect homestead, and share the rewarding feeling of a good harvest with your pals. Use the Shared Saves system to keep playing even while the host is away.

No enemy raids, no hunger, no lost progress - no pressure. Kick back, get creative, or challenge yourself, with lots of tweakable options to fit your unique playstyle.

Upgrade and tune the capabilities and look of your trusty mech. Take care of it through repairs and fuel, and it'll take care of you.

item.title: Worship
item.description:
Title: Worship
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , Strategy
Developer: Chasing Rats Games
Publisher: Chasing Rats Games
Release Date: Nov 4, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 16, 2025




About This Game

Don the robes of a mad cultist who pledges his faith to an eldritch god in exchange for untold powers. Grow your cult base and build monuments to receive unholy blessings and learn new rituals. Embrace your dark side as your cult gradually corrupts the Mortal Realm to plan the arrival of your otherworldly deity.

Command your Flock

To obey the whispers of the Old Ones, you will need an army. Build it by spreading the gospel and converting the godless to your cause. Command your followers through battles and various occult bidding in this pikmin-like mix of real-time strategy, exploration and puzzle solving . Don’t let trivial things like empathy stop you from leading them to certain death.

Draw Blood Rituals

Cast otherworldly spells by drawing blood symbols on the ground. Summon deadly horrors, unleash ghastly projectiles and make toxic frogs rain on your enemies. Your blood is also your ink, but don’t worry too much about it, you are surrounded by followers eager to spill theirs in your place.

Drawing with blood is also key for interacting with various puzzles, shrines and occult ruins you’ll stumble upon during your unholy journey.

End a Living World

Explore a visually unique dark-fantasy living world where four distinct factions wage war. Prepare yourself to face inquisitors of The Last Church, Untamed Akka warriors, witches from the Coven and aberrations from the Unseen Depths. Filled with dark humour and merciless realisations, a grim but equally cute world is waiting for you to end it.

What to Expect

  • A Pikmin-like mix of RTS, exploration and puzzle solving.

  • Command an army of devout followers eager to die for the cause.

  • Draw blood symbols to cast devastating eldritch rituals on the nonbelievers.

  • Meaningful bosses that can singlehandedly end your cult.

  • Eldritch prophecies: Worship’s roguelite progression. Complete challenges during your runs to unlock new gods, more power, skins and more!

  • Vast open areas to explore and corrupt in a world on the verge of collapse.

  • Flavorful hand drawn animations in a distinctive black and white art style with scattered splashes of color.

System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7
    • Processor: Quad Core Processor
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
